speech_de: Seife und Wasser? Das ist meine einzige Schwäche!
scenario: Inside a cosy gut tunnel: a cheeky long noodle-shaped C. diff character with a big round spore knob set back from one end shrugs 'all right, I'm going' while a happy crowd of good gut bacteria characters marches back in from both sides and a big friendly bar of soap with a face blows bubbles through the scene. The kids' teaching point — soap and water beat the spores, and the gut's own good bacteria take their places back — is carried entirely by the picture.

prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080. Composition must be SQUARE, never wide or landscape.

CRITICAL — READ FIRST: (a) the drawing must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES with NO frame, NO border line, NO box and NO white margin band; (b) there must be NO starburst, no radiating rays, no sparkle burst and no radiating lines of any kind anywhere in the picture.

SCENE: inside a cosy tunnel of the gut, the good gut bacteria are moving back in and politely crowding out a cheeky C. diff character, while a big friendly bar of soap leads the clean-up. Playful and reassuring, never scary.
- The C. DIFF character is in the middle of the picture: a LONG, GENTLY CURVED, CHUNKY NOODLE-SHAPED ROD lying on a diagonal, roughly five times longer than it is wide, with smoothly rounded ends. About one quarter of the way in from its LEFT end its body swells into ONE BIG ROUND KNOB — its spore, drawn as a plain round bump with a couple of simple ring lines inside it. A clear length of ordinary body continues past the knob to the rounded left end, so the knob is NOT at the tip. It has a BIG FRIENDLY FACE near its right end: two large round eyes with pupils, curved eyebrows and a wide sheepish grin, plus two tiny stubby arms raised in an "all right, all right, I'm going" shrug.
- The GOOD GUT BACTERIA are a cheerful crowd of six to eight small chunky characters filling the left and right of the tunnel and marching inward: some are short fat sausage-shaped rods, some are round blobs, each with its own simple happy face (two dot eyes and a wobbly smile) and little stubby legs. A few hold hands. They are drawn LARGE and SIMPLE with big open white insides.
- The BAR OF SOAP is a big chunky rounded rectangle block with softly rounded corners, coming in from the lower left, with its own cheerful face (two round eyes and a big smile) and two tiny waving arms. Big simple round and oval BUBBLES of several sizes float up and across the scene from it; each bubble is a plain closed circle with one small crescent highlight line inside it. NO sparkles, NO twinkles, NO star shapes on or around the bubbles.
- The GUT WALL forms the tunnel: big, simple, soft wavy folds along the top and the bottom of the picture with rows of chunky rounded finger-shaped villi bumps hanging from them, running right off the top, bottom, left and right edges of the square.
- Everything is drawn LARGE, SIMPLE and CHUNKY, with generous open white areas inside every shape so a child can colour them in.

STYLE — coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with plenty of white space.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN — the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, motion rays, bubble sparkles or halo of rays behind, around or under any character. NO radiating lines of any kind anywhere. They leave a big empty shape that cannot be removed afterwards.
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box, or vignette. The drawing must NOT sit inside a box of any kind. Do NOT draw a thin black line anywhere near the edge of the image. There must be NO white margin between the artwork and the image edge — the gut folds and villi are CUT OFF by the image edge itself.
- The artwork must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES of the square — the gut wall, folds and villi run right off the top, bottom, left and right edges, with no white margin band and no enclosing outline.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks anywhere.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO blood, no wound, no red marks, no sick, crying, frightened or angry faces, nothing gruesome, nothing to do with toilets or poo.
- NO human figure and no hands.
